sub_questions: Has any published or preprinted work proposed an intervention that CORRECTS revealed-preference consistency on the choices or outputs of an LLM-based or AI agent?
Has any such work proposed an intervention that PROJECTS choices onto the consistent set?
Has any such work proposed an intervention that REPAIRS revealed-preference inconsistency?
Has any such work proposed an intervention that otherwise ENFORCES revealed-preference consistency?
For each such work, is the intervention INFERENCE-TIME or TRAINING-TIME?
Which works merely MEASURE or SCORE consistency, as opposed to intervening? (the contrast class that defines the gap)
Which axiom system does each intervention target — GARP, WARP, SARP, probabilistic coherence, transitivity, or something else?
Does any work perform minimal-perturbation restoration of rationalizability specifically?
Has the relationship between enforced choice-coherence and downstream DECISION QUALITY been empirically tested for LLM agents?
Has the relationship between enforced choice-coherence and downstream TASK PERFORMANCE been empirically tested for LLM agents?
In which DIRECTION do any such tests point — does enforced coherence improve, leave unchanged, or degrade downstream quality?
What does the economics literature (Afriat, Varian, Houtman-Maks) offer as efficiency and repair methods, and has any of it been applied to AI agents?
What does the ML/alignment literature (coherence theorems, Bradley-Terry/RLHF consistency violations, Nash learning from human feedback) say about enforcing versus accepting inconsistency?
Where do the two literatures fail to cite each other, and what is being independently rediscovered as a result?

scope_conditions: the agent must be LLM-based or an AI agent — human revealed-preference work is background only
intervention, not measurement, is the target — measurement work is the contrast class
both inference-time AND training-time interventions are in scope
the two fronts are related but DISTINCT and must be covered separately
downstream-quality evidence counts in EITHER direction (improvement or degradation)
retrieval must be headless — no browser, no interactive login
